40. 若一正四面體的高為 $2\text{ cm}$，則該四面體的體積為

A. $2\text{ cm}^3$。
B. $\sqrt{3}\text{ cm}^3$。
C. $\sqrt{6}\text{ cm}^3$。
D. $3\sqrt{3}\text{ cm}^3$。
reasoning: For a regular tetrahedron, the height h and edge length a satisfy h = a\sqrt{2/3}. Given h = 2\text{ cm}, we find a = 2/\sqrt{2/3} = \sqrt{6}\text{ cm}. The volume V of a regular tetrahedron is V = a^3/(6\sqrt{2}) = (\sqrt{6})^3/(6\sqrt{2}) = \sqrt{6}/\sqrt{2} = \sqrt{3}\text{ cm}^3, which corresponds to option B.
